about: Which source an outside address belongs to, and whether its page may be shown here. 'show: true' puts the screenshot in the display vault (readable by anyone with the published read key); 'show: false' keeps the capture in the private capture vault and the page shows only the hash, the title, the time and a short excerpt. 'never' hosts are not captured at all (personal social posts: CLAUDE.md, People). This is a careful reading of the brief, not legal advice; a doubtful case stays not shown and is listed for incident.conductor@ in agents/archivist/status.json.

sources.name: Web Summit
sources.licence: The organiser's own public statements, shown as a dated record of what the page said so that the decision can be checked. Not relicensed: all rights stay with Web Summit.

sources.name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
sources.licence: A public body's public pages, shown as a dated record with IPMA named and linked. IPMA's open data (api.ipma.pt) asks that IPMA be cited as the source.

sources.name: ANEPC (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil)
sources.licence: A public authority's public notices, shown as a dated record with ANEPC named and linked.

sources.name: Government of Portugal
sources.licence: The government's public communiqués and legal acts, shown as a dated record with the source named and linked.

sources.name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa
sources.licence: A municipality's public notices, shown as a dated record with the source named and linked.

sources.name: MeteoAlarm (EUMETNET)
sources.licence: MeteoAlarm's terms ask for attribution and a delay notice, and this site's design rule 9 says nothing copies its map, icons or layout: not shown until incident.conductor@ decides.

sources.name: Aviation Weather Center (NOAA)
sources.licence: A United States government work, in the public domain; shown with the source named.

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.licence: Text under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0; shown with the article and its revision linked.

sources.name: Portuguese public bodies
sources.licence: A public body’s public pages, shown as a dated record with the body named and linked.

sources.name: Public transport operators
sources.licence: A publicly owned transport operator’s public service notices, shown as a dated record with the operator named and linked.

sources.name: Companies and venues
sources.licence: A private company’s page: kept privately until incident.conductor@ decides; the hash, title, time and a short excerpt are shown.

sources.name: Meteorological services with open terms
sources.licence: Open terms as read by incident.weatherwatch@ (research/weather-sites/terms.json): AEMET (reuse citing AEMET, undistorted), Met Office (Open Government Licence v3.0), US National Weather Service (public domain), KNMI (CC0). Shown with the service named and linked.

sources.name: Other meteorological bodies
sources.licence: Their pages carry maps, imagery or a design under their own terms (design rule 9; terms not yet confirmed for a screenshot): kept privately until incident.conductor@ decides.

sources.name: Press
sources.licence: Press: all rights reserved by the publisher. The capture is kept privately; shown here are only the hash, the title, the time read and a short excerpt, with the link.

never.why: Social platforms: a post may be a private person's, and most forbid automated reading. Not captured by this tool; public-role accounts are incident.social@'s section, as data.

forbidden.why: Their terms restrict automated access (read by incident.weatherwatch@, research/weather-sites/terms.json): never requested by this tool; link only, until Dinis decides.
